# vendor

Each library is pinned, unmodified from jsDelivr, and loads as a classic script from a file. Each folder holds its license.

| Library | Version | License | Files | For |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| preact | 10.29.8 | MIT | `preact/preact.min.umd.js`, `hooks.umd.js` | components (11.x has no UMD build) |
| htm | 3.1.1 | Apache-2.0 | `htm/htm.umd.js` | templates without a build step |
| @preact/signals, signals-core | 2.11.3, 1.14.4 | MIT | `signals/signals-core.min.js`, `signals.min.js` | shared state |
| @antv/x6 | 3.1.8 | MIT | `x6/x6.min.js` | drawing and manipulation on the canvas |
| elkjs | 0.12.0 | EPL-2.0 | `elkjs/elk.bundled.js` | layout |
| tabulator-tables | 6.6.1 | MIT | `tabulator/tabulator.min.js`, `.css` | table views |
| codemirror | 5.65.21 | MIT | `codemirror/`: `codemirror`, `simple`, `show-hint`, `lint`, `matchbrackets` | the formula editor |
| @floating-ui/dom, core | 1.8.0, 1.8.0 | MIT | `floating-ui/floating-ui.core.umd.min.js`, `.dom.umd.min.js` | menus and popovers (utils is bundled into both) |
| tinykeys | 4.0.1 | MIT | `tinykeys/tinykeys.umd.js` | keys |
| @leeoniya/ufuzzy | 1.0.19 | MIT | `ufuzzy/uFuzzy.iife.min.js` | ranking in Find |
| dexie | 4.4.6 | Apache-2.0 | `dexie/dexie.min.js` | the log in the browser |
| pptxgenjs | 4.0.1 | MIT | `pptxgenjs/pptxgen.bundle.js` | PowerPoint export |
| jspdf | 4.2.1 | MIT | `jspdf/jspdf.umd.min.js` | PDF export |
| svg2pdf.js | 2.8.1 | MIT | `svg2pdf/svg2pdf.umd.min.js` | PDF export |
| @azure/msal-browser | 3.28.1 | MIT | `msal/msal-browser.min.js` | signing in to Microsoft 365 |
| IBM Plex Sans (variable) | Fontsource 5.3.0 | OFL-1.1 | `plex/*.woff2`, latin and latin-ext | the interface, formulas included |
